voiceover.creationIntro: Give your motion a voice. Preview the samples and choose your narrator.
voiceover.noVoiceHint: Your motion will be created without narration. You can add a voiceover later in the editor.
voiceover.sampleError: Could not play this sample. Press play to try again.
voiceover.dialogDescription: Choose your voice, edit the script and generate narration for each scene.
voiceover.disabledHint: Enable voiceover in the settings to edit and generate narration.
voiceover.creationHelp: Choose your video's voice. Once the motion is created, write the narration or suggest an AI script, then preview and generate each scene.
voiceover.creationCost: Choosing a voice is free. Script and audio costs will be shown in the editor before generation.
voiceover.voiceRequired: Choose a voice or turn off voiceover to continue.
voiceover.autoFit: Fit scene durations to the voice
voiceover.autoFitHelp: After generation, short scenes will be extended as needed, up to 20s per scene. The video may exceed your chosen duration.
voiceover.creationNext: Your voice is selected. Write the lines below or suggest a script, then generate audio at the displayed price.
voiceover.fitAll: Fit scenes to the voice · free
voiceover.fitFree: Keeps the audio already generated. No new ElevenLabs calls or extra credits.
voiceover.fitSummary: Some segments exceed their scene. Adjusting durations will extend the video from {before}s to {after}s.
voiceover.title: Voiceover
voiceover.description: Scene-by-scene narration, with a voice and volume independent of the music.
voiceover.unavailable: Could not load voices. Check the ElevenLabs configuration and try again.
voiceover.noVoices: No voices are available for this key.
voiceover.scriptHint: The suggested script replaces the narration text below. On-screen titles stay the same.
voiceover.placeholder: Write the sentence to speak for this scene…
voiceover.stale: Regenerate: the text, voice or scene has changed.
voiceover.tooLong: The voice is longer than this scene. Shorten the text and regenerate, or extend the scene.
voiceover.extend: Extend scene to fit this voice
voiceover.extendHint: This extends the video and recalculates cuts on the musical beat.
voiceover.error: Generation failed. Credits for this operation are refunded. Try again.
voiceover.connection: The connection was interrupted. Try again to recover the result without being charged twice.
voiceover.busy: The project changed or a generation is running. Close and reopen Voiceover.
voiceover.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
voiceover.exportBlocked: Open Voiceover before exporting to regenerate the flagged segments, adjust their duration or disable narration.
voiceover.costHint: Audio: {cost} credit per {characters} characters, per scene. Playback and reuse included.
voiceover.unsaved: Save your settings or generate the voice before closing.
voiceover.savedClips: Successful segments are kept if a later generation fails.
voiceover.progress: Generation in progress. Please wait here.
voiceover.languageMismatch: The project language changed. Save the settings and regenerate the narration.
